audited_source.group_preservation: whole trajectories are exchanged only within equal-block-length strata; every row keeps its own features, layout, trajectory membership and fold assignment, and only the target block moves
audited_source.null_statistic_target_authority: the permuted target vector is both fitted and scored, exactly as the audited permutation test scores regression_metrics(permuted targets, permuted fit predictions)
audited_source.related_donor_implementation: src/mineocclude/baselines/shuffled.py::build_donor_assignments (trajectory-level donor derangement used by the grouped_shuffled baseline floor and person-d grouped-null documents)
audited_source.seed_generation: permutation_seed = base_seed + permutation_index, base_seed = 20260720 (core analysis config resampling.permutation_seed, used verbatim by run_grouped_ridge_permutation)
audited_source.temporal_preservation: frames are never rearranged inside a trajectory; the donor block is copied in the recipient's own frame order, so within-trajectory temporal correlation is preserved exactly and neighbouring frame targets are never independently shuffled

authority_mapping.conservatism: 51 of 1,071 rows (4.76%) retain their true feature-target association inside every null replicate, which can only make the null distribution stronger, never weaker
authority_mapping.mapping_rule: the audited permute_trajectory_blocks refuses a length stratum with fewer than two blocks; on this authority the 60-frame stratum holds 17 trajectories and the 51-frame stratum holds exactly one (layout_06_ep12616).  The audited function is therefore called verbatim on the 17-trajectory, 1,020-row equal-length stratum and the singleton block keeps its own target block.  Python's random.shuffle consumes no randomness for a one-element list, so this is bit-identical to running the audited function over all 18 trajectories with the minimum-stratum guard lifted.
unchanged_from_audited_design: permutation unit is the whole trajectory block
frames are never rearranged inside a trajectory
scaler, alpha selection and ridge are refit inside every replicate
the upper-tail statistic is the audited add-one rule

limitations: These controls are exploratory; they are not the confirmatory shuffled-p gate.
No pair holdout, occupancy, U1, U2, or new representation was run.
GLOBAL_MEAN is permutation invariant and is verified numerically, not refit.
One 51-frame trajectory forms a singleton audited length stratum and keeps its own target block in every null replicate.

optimization_equivalence.method: target permutation changes y only; the train-only standardized Gram matrices and their LU factorizations are computed once and reused.  scipy lu_factor/lu_solve call the same LAPACK getrf/getrs pair numpy.linalg.solve uses.

paired_null_authority.note: COARSE_2x6 and FULL_TOKEN_GRID consume the identical permuted target vector for every replicate; the audited permutation depends only on trajectory identity and the seed, never on features, so the two null distributions are exactly paired
paired_null_authority.spearman_note: paired per-replicate macro R2 values are reported in full

predeclared_logic.false: no representation shows an ordered advantage on every frozen seed
predeclared_logic.true: for both COARSE and FULL, every frozen seed's ordered macro R2 exceeds its sample-specific scrambled counterpart by a material margin (more than half the ordered macro R2 magnitude) and, for every frozen seed, a strict majority of layouts show a positive median ordered-minus-scrambled delta

task4_classifications_preserved.note: Task 4 classifications are carried through unchanged; Task 5 controls do not rewrite held-out-layout transfer history

predeclared_logic.bottleneck_false: none of the four criteria holds
predeclared_logic.bottleneck_true: all four predeclared bottleneck criteria hold: ordered beats sample-specific scramble for both controlled representations, the advantage repeats on every independent held-out trajectory, COARSE retains substantial controlled signal, and observed across-layout performance is materially stronger than the audited grouped target null
predeclared_logic.overfit_false: no FULL-overfit criterion holds and every predeclared against-overfit criterion holds
